title: Weddings
headline: A cover band for your wedding.
lead: One live band for the entire wedding day — from the ceremony and first dance to the evening dancefloor.
trustLine: Big-stage experience in an intimate wedding format: ceremony, live first dance, an original song for the couple and a saxophone welcome.
keywords: wedding cover band, live wedding music, wedding saxophonist, first dance live band, bespoke wedding song

blocks.title: Ceremony
blocks.text: An acoustic lineup for the bride's entrance, vows and signing. The repertoire ranges from Perfect to Pachelbel's Canon.
blocks.imageAlt: Saxophonist performing live at a waterfront wedding ceremony

blocks.title: Welcome
blocks.text: Saxophone or piano solo during guest arrival and reception. Jazz, chillout and lounge that never gets in the way of conversation.

blocks.title: First Dance
blocks.text: The video shows a live performance of Perfect. Send your first-dance song so we can discuss the arrangement, length and whether it can be prepared for your wedding date.
blocks.imageAlt: First wedding dance accompanied by Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: An Original Song About the Couple
blocks.text: We can write a song around your story: how you met, the proposal, names and shared memories. We discuss a live surprise performance at the reception and confirm preparation time and availability before booking.
blocks.imageAlt: Original song about the newlyweds performed live at a wedding

blocks.title: Perform Together with the Couple or Family
blocks.text: The couple, parents or friends can sing with the live band. We choose a song and key in advance and agree preparation, rehearsal, soundcheck and the stage entrance.
blocks.imageAlt: Wedding guests performing on stage with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Reception
blocks.text: The main program: 2×45 or 3×30 minutes with breaks, interactive numbers, flash mobs and guest performances.
blocks.imageAlt: Wedding reception with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Late-Night Set
blocks.text: A dance set, 80s, 90s and 2000s party blocks, and the biggest closing hits.
blocks.imageAlt: Late-night wedding dancefloor with Luxury Cover Band

faq.q: How long is the wedding performance?
faq.a: The main reception program is usually 2×45 or 3×30 minutes with breaks. We adapt the timing to the ceremony, welcome, first dance, dinner and late-night set.

faq.q: Which lineup can we book?
faq.a: From an acoustic duo for the ceremony and welcome to a full big band. We offer lineups of 2–20 performers depending on the venue, format and budget.

faq.q: Can you play our first-dance song?
faq.a: Send the title or a link to the song. We will discuss the live arrangement, dance length and preparation needed, then confirm whether it is possible for your date.

faq.q: Can we sing together with the band?
faq.a: Yes. We select the song and key beforehand and agree preparation, rehearsal and soundcheck for the specific performance.

faq.q: Do you bring sound equipment?
faq.a: We bring instruments and part of the equipment. The venue provides the standard technical-rider setup and a sound engineer; we agree the exact list for your venue.
faq.aHtml: We bring instruments and part of the equipment. The venue provides the setup listed in our technical rider and a sound engineer; we agree the exact list for your venue.

faq.q: How do we book and get a quote?
faq.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the date, location and format, and we will send a lineup, timing and quote for your event.

title: Corporate Events
headline: Live music for a corporate event.
lead: Live music for corporate events — from the business program to the dancefloor, tailored to your audience, venue and budget.
trustLine: We plan the welcome set, main sets and employee performances with your host or agency. The sections below show a possible event structure; the final schedule is agreed for your event.
keywords: corporate event cover band, live corporate music, corporate home band

blocks.title: Employee Interaction
blocks.text: Employees sing with the live band. For a prepared performance, we choose the song in advance and coordinate the stage entrance with your host.
blocks.imageAlt: Employee interaction with Luxury Cover Band at a corporate event

blocks.title: Welcome Set
blocks.text: A subtle acoustic background for reception, buffet and networking.

blocks.title: Main Program
blocks.text: 2×45 or 3×30 minutes, built around the brand and occasion. We can integrate a company anthem, jokes and award categories.

blocks.title: Dancefloor
blocks.text: A final set of current pop, rock and Latin hits.
blocks.imageAlt: Corporate dancefloor with Luxury Cover Band

faq.q: Which formats work for a corporate event?
faq.a: From a welcome set and main concert to the final dancefloor. We integrate the band into anything from a product launch to a New Year party.

faq.q: Can employees perform with the band?
faq.a: Yes. We select the song and coordinate the stage entrance with your host. Preparation and rehearsal requirements depend on the chosen performance.

faq.q: Which languages and styles are in the repertoire?
faq.a: 500+ songs in 12 languages: pop, rock, jazz, soul, funk and Latin. We build the program for your audience.

faq.q: Which lineup should we choose?
faq.a: From a compact lineup to a full big band — 2–20 performers, selected for the venue and scale.

faq.q: Can you integrate our brand or company anthem?
faq.a: Yes. We can include a company anthem, award categories and bespoke arrangements in the main program.

faq.q: How do we book and get a quote?
faq.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the date, location and format, and we will send a lineup, timing and quote.

title: New Year Events
seoTitle: Cover Band for New Year and Corporate Parties — LC Band
headline: A cover band for New Year.
lead: Live music for New Year corporate parties, private celebrations and gala dinners: worldwide hits, guest interaction and a dancefloor, from a duo to the full band.
trustLine: We check musician availability for your specific date. Lineup, price, booking conditions and the programme deadline are agreed before the booking is confirmed.
keywords: New Year cover band, corporate Christmas party live band, gala dinner live music

blocks.title: New Year Corporate Party
blocks.text: A welcome set, a 2×45 or 3×30-minute show with awards and a company anthem, and a dance finale. We coordinate timing with your host and agency.
blocks.imageAlt: New Year corporate dancefloor with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Private New Year Party
blocks.text: A private celebration in a restaurant, loft or country house. We tailor the program to the theme — retro, masquerade or Gatsby — and to the venue's sound limits.
blocks.imageAlt: Luxury Cover Band at a private New Year party

blocks.title: Gala Dinner and Ceremonies
blocks.text: Jazz and lounge for dinner, the formal program and live versions of hits. Choose a compact saxophone lineup or the full band.
blocks.imageAlt: Saxophonist performing at an evening gala dinner

blocks.title: December Dates
blocks.text: Send the date, venue, performance time and preferred lineup. We check musician availability, prepare a proposal and agree booking conditions. An enquiry alone does not reserve the date.
blocks.imageAlt: Full Luxury Cover Band lineup at a December corporate event

faq.q: When should we book for a New Year corporate party?
faq.a: Start by checking availability for your date. Send the venue, time and preferred lineup. After confirming the musicians, we agree the price and booking conditions.

faq.q: Do you perform on 31 December and New Year's Eve?
faq.a: Yes, by prior arrangement. Send us the date and venue and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: Can you perform a themed New Year program?
faq.a: Yes. We have six ready-made themed programs and can build a dedicated masquerade, retro or Gatsby set for your evening.

faq.q: How much does a December performance cost?
faq.a: The price depends on lineup, duration, date, venue and additional services. Send the details on WhatsApp; we will prepare a proposal after checking availability.

faq.q: What does the venue need to provide?
faq.a: The standard technical rider: a stage or performance area, power and basic sound. We bring part of the backline and coordinate the rest with the venue.

faq.q: Can employees participate?
faq.a: Yes. We can discuss an employee performance with live accompaniment. We select the song and agree preparation and the stage entrance with your host.

title: Birthdays / Anniversaries
headline: A live concert for a birthday.
lead: A birthday concert built around the guest of honor: their favorite era, artists and songs.
trustLine: From an intimate family celebration to a large stage: a surprise set of favorite songs, guests performing with the band and a program built around the person.
keywords: birthday cover band, anniversary live music, surprise birthday concert

blocks.title: Surprise Gift
blocks.text: A short surprise set of 3–5 songs is a separate birthday-gift format. We agree the songs, lineup and preparation beforehand; it does not include a full-evening programme.
blocks.imageAlt: Luxury Cover Band surprise performance at a birthday

blocks.title: Guests on Stage
blocks.text: A home-band format: friends of the guest of honor can come on stage and sing with the band.
blocks.imageAlt: Birthday guests singing with Luxury Cover Band

blocks.title: Retro Set
blocks.text: A program for the guest of honor's era: the 70s, 80s, 90s or 2000s.
blocks.imageAlt: Retro birthday set by Luxury Cover Band

faq.q: What can we arrange for an anniversary?
faq.a: A surprise set of favorite songs, guests performing with the live band and a retro block from the 70s, 80s, 90s or 2000s.

faq.q: Can you perform a surprise concert?
faq.a: We can discuss a separate surprise set of 3–5 favourite songs. Send a playlist and date so we can confirm preparation and arrange the entrance.

faq.q: Which lineup and duration?
faq.a: A full-evening programme usually has 2×45 or 3×30-minute sets with breaks. A short surprise set of 3–5 songs is agreed separately. We select a lineup of 2–20 performers for the format, venue and date.

faq.q: Can guests come on stage and sing?
faq.a: Yes. In the home-band format, friends sing with the live band after preparing the song in advance.

faq.q: How do we book?
faq.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the date, location and format, and we will send a lineup, timing and quote.
